visible_item.prompt: Maya started painting the fence at 8:00. At noon, she was still working. Complete the sentence using the cue (Maya / paint the fence / for four hours): At noon, ____.
visible_item.target_answer: At noon, Maya had been painting the fence for four hours.
accepted_answers: Maya had been painting the fence for four hours
